description: Live USD price of any ERC-20 token on Base from on-chain DEX quotes (Uniswap v3 0.05/0.3/1% pools and Aerodrome, against USDC and WETH; WETH converted with Chainlink ETH/USD). Returns the best executable route, every route's price, the price impact of selling $1,000, and flags for thin liquidity or disagreeing pools. Price: $0.003 USDC on Base per call (x402).
name: base_token_price
